routes.name: local mutant stabilization
routes.hypothesis: A molecule binding a reproducible local or nearby allosteric site may increase the stable cellular abundance of R611Q TSC2.
minimum_computational_tests: Verify exact residue and chain mapping in PDB 7DL2 and 9CE3.
Assess local map quality and modeled atoms around residue 611.
Generate a restrained R611Q structural ensemble without treating predicted differences as evidence.
Compare solvent exposure, local contacts, flexibility, and pockets across wild-type and mutant ensembles with at least two methods.
minimum_laboratory_tests: Measure R611Q abundance and half-life relative to wild type.
Test proteasome dependence and R611Q ubiquitination.
Confirm direct target engagement with at least two orthogonal physical principles before interpreting stabilization.
falsifiers: No reproducible local structural perturbation or persistent ligandable site is detected.
A candidate binds but does not improve R611Q abundance, half-life, or the prespecified protein-state readout.
The apparent effect is aggregation, assay interference, or general proteostasis modulation.

routes.name: TSC1-TSC2 interface stabilization
routes.hypothesis: A molecule binding at or allosterically coupled to the TSC1-TSC2 interface may increase R611Q complex formation.
minimum_computational_tests: Map residue 611 relative to the experimentally modeled TSC1-TSC2 interface without assuming a salt bridge.
Compare interface geometry and pocket persistence across experimental conformers and restrained mutant models.
Separate a mutant-only pocket from a site shared with wild type.
Counter-screen hypotheses for predicted disruption of the native wild-type complex.
minimum_laboratory_tests: Measure TSC1-TSC2 complex formation directly by co-immunoprecipitation or an equivalent native-complex method.
Measure R611Q and TSC1 abundance in the same experiment.
Test target dependence in wild-type, R611Q, and TSC2-null backgrounds.
falsifiers: Residue 611 is not structurally coupled to an addressable interface site.
A candidate destabilizes wild-type complex formation.
A candidate changes downstream signaling without improving R611Q complex formation.

routes.name: distal allosteric stabilization
routes.hypothesis: A molecule binding a distal TSC2 site may favor a complex-competent and GAP-competent state without binding near residue 611.
minimum_computational_tests: Identify reproducible distal pockets and plausible coupling paths in the experimental ensemble.
Demonstrate that the proposed site is not selected solely because one scoring method ranks it highly.
Evaluate structural effects on both wild-type and R611Q ensembles.
minimum_laboratory_tests: Measure complex formation and a Rheb-GAP-proximal readout.
Demonstrate that any pathway effect is lost or materially reduced in a TSC2-null counter-screen.
falsifiers: No reproducible coupling between the site and complex/GAP state is observed.
The candidate suppresses mTORC1 equally in TSC2-null cells.
The candidate binds but does not improve complex or GAP-proximal function.

routes.name: no structurally plausible rescue route
routes.hypothesis: The R611Q phenotype may not be addressable by a small-molecule structural rescue strategy.
minimum_computational_tests: Apply the same ensemble, pocket, uncertainty, and method-agreement rules used for positive routes.
Report absent, unstable, inaccessible, or method-disagreed sites without lowering thresholds post hoc.
minimum_laboratory_tests: Establish whether R611Q has a remediable abundance, turnover, complex, or intrinsic-function defect.
Terminate if no tractable construct or discriminating assay exists.
falsifiers: A reproducible site and route-specific laboratory assay are both established.

routing_rule: No route advances to a calibrated compound pilot until it has a reproducible structural site, an assay capable of falsifying the proposed rescue mechanism, and a lawful per-artifact tool/data plan.
selection_rule: Routes may coexist. The synthesis does not select a winning route and treats RH-0 as an equally valid outcome.
